It should either reuse the context in research or just create another SOW research agent that goes out, does a similar thing. There should be an input for total budget as the constraint and timeline as in start date and estimated weeks the project should take as per the human. We probably should have a research agent for this because I'd like the research agent to go out and find comparables around pricing or what other similar solutions may have cost or whatever it can use to derive a mid-range cost. So not high, not low. Bring it to the mid-range. Create a high-level project plan that will be included in the statement of work. So there are dates, milestones, and a timeline attached to each of the parent milestones, and then each task that will be completed in each milestone. And then for any customer required involvement, there should be a section in the document where it outlines in a checklist kind of fashion requirements from the client. Finally, the statement of work should end with a fixed bid price, an estimated time to completion, and a signature box. It should then be passed off to a contracts review agent that reviews the statement of work, looks for any missing pieces or critiques, and then sends it back to the SOW writing agent and the loop continues until they both conclude. The statement of work is solid. Finally, the upload attachments. There should be branded as NATIVE, AI Consulting Agency.

I've also added relevant proposal and research data types in `types/index.ts`.
